name: methods
value: Survival was estimated using the Kaplan-Meier method. There were no failures in the analysis sample, so the groups were not compared with the log-rank test. Median survival time with 95% confidence intervals is reported. Restricted mean survival time was computed up to 2 years with 95% confidence intervals based on the Greenwood variance formula. Analysis performed in Stata 17 (StataCorp, College Station, TX).
